name: Oscar Lasko YMCA Camp (Camp OLY)
description_short: YMCA day camp based at the Oscar Lasko YMCA in downtown West Chester for ages 3 to 15. Traditional campers travel to the Coatesville YMCA several times a week for nature, outdoor time and swimming and take field trips every other week; specialty, sports, gymnastics, ninja parkour, STEM, esports and BumbleBee adaptive camps stay at Oscar Lasko.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least two weeks before the camp week for a refund of fees paid, less the non-refundable $35 a week deposit; no refunds or changes within two weeks of the start, or for illness.
special_needs_notes: BumbleBee adaptive camp (ages 6 to 12, full or half day) serves campers with developmental and intellectual disabilities who need more support.

sessions.name: Week 1: Jurassic Jungle (no camp Friday June 19)

notes: 2026 prices shown are the guest (non-member) weekly rates: traditional camp $385 (members $310); sports camps $385; Progressive Gymnastics $491 ($412); BumbleBee adaptive $426 ($328), half day $225 ($153); half day specialty camps $227 to $332; CIT $377 ($305). Week 1 is four days and prorated; the planner runs to week 10 (August 17 to 21). A Y Scholarship camp (ages 6 to 14, same price) registers in branch only. Camp 9 to 4; Morning SPARK 7 to 9 is $25 a week; 4 to 6 pm is included.
